title: Normalized inverse projection square for etale precomposition
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, u:U→X a separated finite-type etale morphism and f:X→S a separated finite-type morphism of Noetherian schemes; suppose f and h=u≫f are compactifiable [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-asd-compactifiable, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Fix a graph-normalized datum N [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization]. Set E=Du_!, F=Rf_!, H=Rh_!, V=u*, and c:EF≅H equal to the specified etaleAmbientLeftComparison for the chosen compactifications [def-sp-etale-adjoint-chart-comparison]. Let q_f,q_h be the coefficient-first inverse projections [def-asd-tensor-mate-inverse-projection], Q(B,M):E(VB⊗ᴸM)→B⊗ᴸEM the sum-extension tensor comparison [lem-asd-etale-sum-extension-tensor], and t_M:(Vf*K)⊗ᴸM→h*K⊗ᴸM induced by inverse pullback composition [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. For every unbounded K∈D(S_et,A) and M∈D(U_et,A), in Lean composition order, F(Q(f*K,M)) ≫ q_f(K,EM) ≫ (K⊗ᴸ-)(c_M) = c_(Vf*K⊗ᴸM) ≫ H(t_M) ≫ q_h(K,M). This statement involves no exceptional right adjoint or dualizing object.

proof.text: Use the proper/open tower for the chosen compactifications of f and h. Apply the projection composition and comparison theorems to identify its projection with that of h. Noetherian hypotheses allow a compactification of u by Nagata.

theorem etalePrecompProjection
    (A : Type (v + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A)
    {U X S : Scheme.{v}} (u : U ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Etale u] [IsSeparated u] [LocallyOfFiniteType u] [QuasiCompact u]
    [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated (u ≫ f)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (u ≫ f)] [QuasiCompact (u ≫ f)]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification (u ≫ f)]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A U) :
    let c := etaleAmbientLeftComparison A N u f
      (HasCompactification.compactification f)
      (HasCompactification.compactification (u ≫ f))
    R(f)_![ModuleCat A].map
        (etaleSumExtensionTensorComparison A u
          ((f)^*[ModuleCat A].mapDerivedCategory.obj K) M) ≫
        (tensorMateInverseProjection A f K).app
          ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat A) u inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat A) S).obj K).map (c.hom.app M) =
      c.hom.app (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat A) U).obj
          ((u)^*[ModuleCat A].mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((f)^*[ModuleCat A].mapDerivedCategory.obj K))).obj M) ≫
        R(u ≫ f)_![ModuleCat A].map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat A) U).map
            ((unboundedEtaleUpperStarCompIso A u f).inv.app K)).app M) ≫
        (tensorMateInverseProjection A (u ≫ f) K).app M
